description: For approved ProductClank scouts: the founder posts picked for you today, each with the post, why it fits, a drafted opener, its status and your signup/call links. Free, read-only. Use it when the user asks 'what deals do you have for me?'. Show each deal briefly (founder, post, the opener) and let the user pick. A deal matched to them is theirs alone for 12h, then open to every scout. If the user is not a scout (403 not_a_scout / scout_not_approved), relay the message: they apply at https://www.productclank.com/scouts.
name: get_scout_deals
title: Get my scout deals
